- Approval window: Our current template says "prior written consent" but doesn't specify a timeline — I agree it should be explicit. From an ops perspective a 10 business day review window is reasonable; I will check with legal.
- Brand assets: We have a logo guidelines PDF and high-res assets. Olga, I can share the Drive folder once Laura signs off on the scope.

Karthik / Maria — quick legal pass below. I kept it as narrow as possible to avoid procurement back-and-forth but still protect trademark and testimonial quality.

Suggested redline (Order Form publicity section):
"Customer Publicity and Brand Use. Subject to the Customer's prior written approval, Redwood may include Customer's name and a brief non-confidential description of Customer's use of the Services in Redwood's marketing materials, case studies, and website. Conversely, Customer may use Redwood's name and trademarks for marketing purposes only as follows: (i) Customer shall submit proposed copy and any logo artwork to Redwood for approval at least ten (10) business days prior to publication; (ii) Redwood shall provide written approval or reasonable redlines within ten (10) business days of receipt; (iii) Approval shall not be unreasonably withheld; (iv) Any use of a Customer quote, testimonial, or confidential information requires separate written permission; (v) Requested trademark files and brand guidelines shall be provided via the Drive link below."

Notes / exceptions:
- We should add a clause about logo escrow for logo assets if the customer requests proof of authorization for marketing collateral (we can add language to provide a brand-usage attestation).
- For formal press releases that reference either party's confidential product roadmaps or metrics, we'll require separate sign-off from the VP level (we can capture that in the MSA as an exception category).

I've attached a quick redline of the Order Form with the above inserted. Olga — please share the logo_guidelines.pdf and the Drive folder with Maria when we agree.
